author: Spoookeh
body:
Hey guys, Spookz here and I recently built a CTW map. I hope you like it!

May I present to you: Outpost
This is a CTW, 10v10 OR 15v15 map made entirely by myself, Demo_Spookzz. 


This map took me about a week to make but may need tweaking a bit. I took aspects of the gameplay I enjoy myself and combined it with some aesthetics. Any feedback would be great! 

NOTE: I am currently working on the YAML.

Images- http://imgur.com/a/7VXhv

YAML- Coming soon

Download- Coming soon


Orange team: Must capture both pink and blue wools

Lime team- Must capture both red and yellow wools

Spawn kit- Leather helmet (dyed), Chain chestplate, Leather leggings (dyed), leather boots (dyed), wood sword, bow, 64 arrows, 2 golden apples, 16 steak, stained class (lime/orange), stone axe, 32 spruce wood.


Once again, any feedback is appreciated :)

replies.author: Robin_DD_J
replies.body:
Some things that you can probably improve!

I've already told you this on the server, but I still find the path a bit too small, it's very easy to block up and making a defense on it, won't be fun.

I would probably add atleast a stonesword, because a wooden sword with leather armor won't deal that much damage and rusher would easily get into the wool rooms. It wouldn't be a challange.

As some have said, screenshots with f1 and a default texturepack would be nice!

Otherwise it looks pretty decent! Good job

replies.body: The map looks a bit small, but depending on the team size, it's probably fine. I'd suggest spawning people with an axe (stone/iron) and a little less wood, as I can predict a massive amount of block spam everywhere.

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
@Robin_DD_J Thanks for the suggestions! I'm going to increase the outward path side but I think a wooden sword was a good idea as at the moment it is very hard to get to the wool room.
@kycraft I personally prefer small maps so that is where I got my inspiration from. I am going to limit the amount of wood as well because it is such a small map. Again, thanks for feedback!

replies.author: RightSide
replies.body:
Here's some area to improve if you want:

  • Make the ground thicker
  • Make it a bigger map
  • Not as simple
  • More bridges in centre
  • Add more structures 
  • Less blocky
Not all of these need adding but I would consider adding some of these.
Overall it's a good map and nice idea! :) I don't normally do posts like these just has some spare time! :P
Here's what I give it:

Aesthetics: 6/10
Creativity: 8/10
Gameplay: 6/10

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Thanks Element, great feedback! 
  • As for the ground thickness, I need to add the bedrock bottom and stone filling it up.  This is just the top layer so far.
  • I wanted to make an over the river area kinda like the outposts on the trees so that you could have rushing opportunities on top but it never seemed to work.
  • If I wanted to add more structures, I would need to expand it and that would mean a lot more work considering the placement of the wool rooms and the river in the middle (I don't see how it is blocky as well...?).
Once again, thanks for the feedback and I think that I'll try and implement some of these ideas!
